newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Two injured in Czech exchange booth explosion.
newsitem.headline: Two injured in Czech exchange booth explosion.

text.p: Two people suffered minor injuries when an explosion occurred on Friday evening at a currency exchange kiosk just off of Prague's historic Old town square, police said.

Police at the scene said both of the injured were taken to hospital for cuts from flying glass. They did not say if the injured were foreigners or Czechs and the cause of the explosion was not immediately known.
The area, usually filled with tourists viewing one of the few historic city squares in Europe to remain intact in World War Two, was nearly empty at the time of the explosion.
